name: Civitai Sensei
description:
Civitai Sensei is a chat companion that lives inside Civitai and answers with the catalog in hand.

Before it replies, Sensei searches Civitai models using your own words and attaches what it finds — up to eight models with their type, stats, versions and tags — so an answer is grounded in what is actually on the site rather than what a language model half-remembers. The Research panel shows you exactly what was retrieved, and you can search from it yourself. Searching costs nothing; a reply costs 1 Buzz, and your balance is shown before you send.

Conversations stay put. Sensei keeps multiple sessions side by side, so a thread about lighting does not get tangled up with a thread about training settings. Sessions and their messages are saved to your own per-user app storage, where no other user can read them.

Three models are available: DeepSeek V3, GPT-4o mini, and Dolphin Mistral 24B, an uncensored option. Civitai's content policy still applies to every reply — when one is withheld, Sensei tells you so plainly instead of failing silently.

This is an early release. Sensei looks up models; it does not yet read images, articles or your own generations.

scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Generates chat completions via the orchestrator; each response spends the viewer's Buzz within the per-message budget.
scopeJustifications.buzz:read:self: Reads the viewer's Buzz balance to display it and gate generation when balance is insufficient.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:read: Reads session history and settings from per-user KV storage.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:write: Writes session history and settings to per-user KV storage.
